name: Loam Notes
tagline: A quiet place for notes that are still growing.
description: Loam Notes keeps a single folder of plain text files and gets out of the way while you write.
Everything is stored on disk in a format you can read without the app.

features.title: Plain files
features.body: Notes are Markdown files in a folder you choose.

features.title: Quiet editor
features.body: One column, no sidebar noise, keyboard first.
